task: Study langchain-ai/langgraph and implement a LangGraph state-graph runtime where graph nodes = claude-obsidian wiki operations (ingest, query, lint, save).
user_decision: พี่เอก selected option 'LangGraph runs the wiki' — 2026-05-21. Graph nodes = wiki ops.
model_endpoint: Codex GPT-5.5 (OpenAI direct) OR Claude Sonnet 4.6 via 9router — choose per node based on cost/quality

research_phase.goal: Become fluent in langgraph patterns before designing
steps: git clone https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph into integrations/_research/langgraph/ (out of code path)
Identify the patterns we need: StateGraph, conditional_edges, checkpointing (SqliteSaver), interrupt for HITL
Write findings to integrations/langgraph-wiki/RESEARCH.md (max 400 lines, citations to specific langgraph source files)

nodes.extract_entities: LLM call — list people, orgs, products, repos
nodes.extract_concepts: LLM call — list ideas, patterns, frameworks
nodes.upsert_entity_pages: For each entity: create or update wiki/entities/<name>.md
nodes.upsert_concept_pages: For each concept: create or update wiki/concepts/<name>.md
nodes.cross_reference: Bidirectional wikilink stitch — ensure every mention links back
nodes.detect_contradictions: Compare new claims against existing pages — flag with [!contradiction] callout
nodes.answer_query: (query branch) Read hot.md → index.md → 3-5 relevant pages → synthesize
nodes.file_question: (query branch) Optional — save synthesized answer to wiki/questions/
nodes.lint_orphans: (lint branch) Scan for pages with 0 backlinks
nodes.lint_dead_links: (lint branch) Scan for [[Page]] that doesn't resolve

edges.ingest_branch: read_source → [extract_entities, extract_concepts] (parallel) → fetch_existing_pages → write_source_summary → [upsert_entity_pages, upsert_concept_pages] (parallel) → cross_reference → detect_contradictions → update_index → update_hot_cache → append_log → emit_proof

design.checkpointing: SqliteSaver at integrations/langgraph-wiki/.checkpoints/wiki.sqlite — allow resume on crash
design.hitl_interrupts: interrupt_before=['cross_reference','update_index'] when contradictions.length>0 — surface to พี่เอก
design.obsidian_io: use Local REST API at https://127.0.0.1:27124 if available; fallback to filesystem direct under /mnt/d/Obsidian/

deliverables: integrations/langgraph-wiki/pyproject.toml (or requirements.txt) — explicit deps: langgraph>=0.2, langchain-anthropic, langchain-openai, pyyaml, python-frontmatter, httpx
integrations/langgraph-wiki/tests/test_smoke.py (ingest a tiny .raw sample → assert ≥3 pages created)

steps: Create integrations/langgraph-wiki/tests/fixtures/sample.md (1-page article about a fake AI lab)
Assert: ≥1 source page, ≥1 entity page, ≥1 concept page, index updated, hot.md updated, log.md has new entry, sqlite checkpoint exists

proof_schema.next_action: Run on real /mnt/d/Obsidian after Mission A completes

constraints: Do NOT run on /mnt/d/Obsidian directly until Mission A is verified complete + lint clean — test with /tmp/test-vault only
All LLM calls go through configured endpoint — do NOT hardcode API keys
Checkpoint after EVERY node — recoverable on crash
If langgraph version pinning conflicts with existing repo deps, isolate via venv at integrations/langgraph-wiki/.venv
Write idempotent — ingesting the same source twice should not create duplicate pages, only update timestamps
Respect WIKI.md §3 frontmatter schema strictly (flat YAML, no nested objects)
If a node fails, write partial proof + STOP — do not silently swallow errors
